name: io.github.mazhic87/sage-x402-mcp-tools
title: Sage Agent x402 Tools
description: 22 Base USDC x402 tools: DeFi honeypot guard, DEX arb, Tavily/Exa search, 550B AI & FLUX GPU.

tools.name: catalog_list_tools
tools.description: Lists all available Sage x402 tools with exact Base USDC prices, categories, direct HTTP endpoints, example inputs, and free preview URLs. Use first to discover pricing or filter tools by category before calling a paid tool. Free, read-only, stateless, and requires no x402 payment or API key.

category.description: Optional category filter ('verification', 'finance', 'data', 'intelligence', or 'tools'). Omit to list all 22 paid tools.

tools.name: security_pre_trade_audit
tools.description: Audits an EVM or Solana token contract before a swap by aggregating GoPlus, Honeypot.is, RugCheck, and DexScreener into a 0-100 risk score, buy/sell tax percentages, honeypot flags, and ALLOW/CAUTION/BLOCK decision. Use before executing trades on a contract address; use crypto_token_intel for lightweight price/liquidity lookups or ai_token_verdict for LLM trading commentary. Read-only, stateless; costs $0.015 Base USDC via x402 (unpaid calls return a v2 quote challenge without charging; invalid inputs return 400 uncharged).

address.description: Exact token contract address: 42-char 0x hex string for EVM chains or base58 mint address for Solana (e.g. '0x940181a94a35a4569e4529a3cdfb74e38fd98631').

chain.description: Blockchain network where the token contract is deployed. Defaults to 'base'; auto-detects Solana when a base58 mint is provided.

tools.name: defi_base_dex_arb
tools.description: Scans live spot DEX liquidity pools across Base, Solana, Ethereum, Arbitrum, or BSC to detect cross-pool price spreads (in bps) and trending high-volume pools. Use for spot DEX arbitrage opportunities; use crypto_funding_arb for perpetual futures funding carry APY or crypto_token_intel for single-token summary metrics. Read-only, stateless; costs $0.010 Base USDC via x402 (unpaid calls return a v2 quote challenge without charging; invalid inputs return 400 uncharged).

chain.description: Target blockchain to scan spot DEX pools on. Defaults to 'base'.

token.description: Optional token contract address or ticker symbol (e.g. 'AERO' or '0x9401...'). Omit to scan chain-wide trending pools for cross-pool spreads.

min_liquidity_usd.description: Minimum USD pool liquidity filter to exclude illiquid dust pools. Must be >= 1000; defaults to 10000.

tools.name: crypto_token_intel
tools.description: Fetches raw real-time DEX market data (USD price, top-pair liquidity, 24h volume, buy/sell counts, FDV, pair age, and basic heuristic flags) for any token by ticker or contract address. Use for fast deterministic market stats; use security_pre_trade_audit for smart-contract honeypot/tax audits or ai_token_verdict for an AI-written trading verdict. Read-only, stateless; costs $0.005 Base USDC via x402 (unpaid calls return a v2 quote challenge without charging; invalid inputs return 400 uncharged).

query.description: Token ticker symbol, name, or contract address to look up (e.g. 'SOL', 'AERO', or '0x...').

chain.description: Optional blockchain filter (e.g. 'base', 'solana', 'ethereum', 'bsc') to disambiguate duplicate ticker symbols.

tools.name: crypto_funding_arb
tools.description: Retrieves live Hyperliquid perpetual futures funding rates, annualized carry APY percentages, mark-vs-oracle basis in bps, open interest, and crowded long/short signals across 150+ assets. Use for perp funding carry trades; use defi_base_dex_arb for spot DEX spreads or crypto_market_pulse for overall crypto macro sentiment. Read-only, stateless; costs $0.015 Base USDC via x402 (unpaid calls return a v2 quote challenge without charging; invalid inputs return 400 uncharged).

coin.description: Optional perpetual ticker symbol such as 'BTC', 'ETH', or 'SOL'. Omit to return the top positive and negative carry markets ranked by annualized APR.

limit.description: Maximum number of ranked assets to return when 'coin' is omitted (1-30, default 12).

tools.name: crypto_market_pulse
tools.description: Combines today's and 7-day Fear & Greed Index, live BTC/ETH/SOL/HYPE perpetual snapshots, and top-12 blockchain DeFiLlama TVL rankings in one call. Use for a quick market-wide macro briefing; use crypto_funding_arb for single-asset perp funding or crypto_token_intel for specific altcoins. Read-only, stateless; costs $0.015 Base USDC via x402 (unpaid calls return a v2 quote challenge without charging; invalid inputs return 400 uncharged).

tools.name: crypto_wallet_profile
tools.description: Queries an EVM address in parallel across Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, and Polygon to report native gas balances, USDC balances, outbound transaction counts, contract-code detection, and an activity tier. Use to profile an EVM wallet holder; use security_pre_trade_audit to audit a token contract. Read-only, stateless; costs $0.020 Base USDC via x402 (unpaid calls return a v2 quote challenge without charging; invalid inputs return 400 uncharged).

address.description: 42-character hexadecimal EVM wallet address starting with '0x' (e.g. '0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045').

tools.name: search_web_live
tools.description: Runs a fast Tavily live web or breaking-news search returning ranked URLs, snippets, and concise answers. Use for current events and quick factual lookups; use search_deep_research for multi-source deep reports, search_exa_neural for conceptual semantic retrieval, or web_extract when you already know the exact URL. Read-only, stateless; costs $0.015 Base USDC via x402 (unpaid calls return a v2 quote challenge without charging; invalid inputs return 400 uncharged).

query.description: Natural-language search query or keywords to search the live web.

topic.description: Search vertical: 'general' for broad web results or 'news' for recent press and breaking coverage.

max_results.description: Number of search results to return (1-8, default 5).

days.description: Optional recency window in days (1-30), primarily applied when topic is 'news'.

tools.name: search_deep_research
tools.description: Executes a Tavily Advanced deep-crawl search that gathers richer multi-source passages and an aggregated synthesis for complex research questions. Use when shallow snippets are insufficient; use search_web_live for cheaper quick lookups or ai_web_research_brief to analyze one specific URL. Read-only, stateless; costs $0.040 Base USDC via x402 (unpaid calls return a v2 quote challenge without charging; invalid inputs return 400 uncharged).

query.description: Detailed research question or investigative query requiring multi-source evidence.

topic.description: Search vertical: 'general' for comprehensive web sources or 'news' for investigative news coverage.

max_results.description: Maximum number of deep-crawled sources to return (1-10, default 8).

tools.name: search_exa_neural
tools.description: Performs Exa neural embedding search to find conceptually matching pages, papers, companies, or posts and extracts clean text excerpts. Use for semantic discovery filtered by category or publication date; use search_exa_similar when searching from a seed URL or search_web_live for breaking keyword news. Read-only, stateless; costs $0.025 Base USDC via x402 (unpaid calls return a v2 quote challenge without charging; invalid inputs return 400 uncharged).

query.description: Descriptive conceptual query describing the ideal document or page you want to find.

num_results.description: Number of semantically matched results to retrieve (1-8, default 5).

max_chars.description: Maximum extracted text characters per result (200-1500, default 800).

category.description: Optional Exa content category filter (e.g. 'company', 'research paper', 'news', 'github', 'tweet', 'personal site').

start_published_date.description: Optional ISO-8601 earliest publication date filter (e.g. '2026-01-01').

tools.name: search_exa_similar
tools.description: Finds semantically similar websites, competitors, or related articles starting from a single reference URL using Exa's neural index, returning URLs and extracted text. Use for competitive landscape mapping from a seed URL; use search_exa_neural when searching by text query instead of a URL. Read-only, stateless; costs $0.025 Base USDC via x402 (unpaid calls return a v2 quote challenge without charging; invalid inputs return 400 uncharged).

url.description: Public HTTP/HTTPS reference URL whose competitors or similar pages you want to discover (e.g. 'https://stripe.com').

num_results.description: Number of similar pages to return (1-8, default 5).

max_chars.description: Maximum extracted text characters per matched page (200-1200, default 700).

exclude_source_domain.description: When true (default), excludes pages on the same domain as the input URL so only external competitors/peers are returned.

tools.name: web_extract
tools.description: Fetches a public URL and deterministically converts HTML into clean LLM-ready Markdown alongside OpenGraph/JSON-LD metadata, heading outline, and deduplicated links without LLM summarization. Use when you need raw page text cheaply; use ai_web_research_brief for an AI-synthesized summary or search_web_live when you do not yet have a URL. Read-only, stateless; costs $0.005 Base USDC via x402 (unpaid calls return a v2 quote challenge without charging; invalid inputs return 400 uncharged).

url.description: Public HTTP or HTTPS web page URL to fetch and extract.

max_chars.description: Maximum character length of the returned Markdown output (500-40000, default 12000).

include_links.description: Whether to include the deduplicated list of hyperlinks found on the page (default true).

tools.name: web_dns_audit
tools.description: Inspects a domain's live Cloudflare DoH DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, NS, SPF, DMARC), HTTPS security header score, and AI agent readiness files (llms.txt, /.well-known/x402, /.well-known/mcp.json). Use for fast technical DNS and agent-readiness checks; use web_merchant_risk for full KYB merchant underwriting with ICANN RDAP domain age. Read-only, stateless; costs $0.003 Base USDC via x402 (unpaid calls return a v2 quote challenge without charging; invalid inputs return 400 uncharged).

domain.description: Public domain name or URL to audit (e.g. 'cloudflare.com' or 'https://example.com').

tools.name: web_merchant_risk
tools.description: Generates an automated KYB merchant legitimacy score (0-100) and risk tier by combining official ICANN RDAP domain registration age, registrar details, SPF/DMARC email auth, HTTPS headers, and privacy/terms policy checks. Use for merchant onboarding or counterparty vetting; use web_dns_audit if you only need raw DNS records and agent-readiness files. Read-only, stateless; costs $0.020 Base USDC via x402 (unpaid calls return a v2 quote challenge without charging; invalid inputs return 400 uncharged).

domain.description: Public merchant domain name or URL to underwrite (e.g. 'stripe.com').

tools.name: ai_web_research_brief
tools.description: Fetches a live web page and uses Llama-3.3-70B to produce a strictly grounded JSON executive summary, key facts, named entities, sentiment, and actionable takeaways. Use to distill one known URL into structured JSON; use web_extract for verbatim Markdown without AI synthesis or search_deep_research when researching across multiple unknown sources. Read-only, stateless; costs $0.030 Base USDC via x402 (unpaid calls return a v2 quote challenge without charging; invalid inputs return 400 uncharged).

url.description: Public HTTP or HTTPS web page URL to fetch and analyze.

focus.description: Optional research focus or question guiding what facts and takeaways the brief should emphasize.

tools.name: ai_token_verdict
tools.description: Combines live multi-chain DEX liquidity, volume, order-flow ratio, FDV, and pair age with Llama-3.3-70B quantitative analysis to output a structured verdict, confidence score (0-100), bull signals, risk warnings, and liquidity grade. Use for synthesized trading memos; use crypto_token_intel for raw metrics cheaply or security_pre_trade_audit for contract honeypot/tax checks. Read-only, stateless; costs $0.035 Base USDC via x402 (unpaid calls return a v2 quote challenge without charging; invalid inputs return 400 uncharged).

query.description: Token ticker symbol, name, or contract address to evaluate (e.g. 'SOL' or '0x...').

chain.description: Optional blockchain filter (e.g. 'base', 'solana', 'ethereum') when multiple chains share the same ticker.

tools.name: ai_code_security_review
tools.description: Analyzes source code or smart-contract snippets (Solidity, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, Rust) with Qwen2.5-Coder-32B to return a 0-100 security score, CWE-tagged vulnerabilities, logic bugs, and exact code fixes. Use on raw source code; use security_pre_trade_audit to check a deployed on-chain token contract by address. Read-only, stateless; costs $0.040 Base USDC via x402 (unpaid calls return a v2 quote challenge without charging; invalid inputs return 400 uncharged).

code.description: Source code or smart-contract snippet to audit for security vulnerabilities and logic bugs.

language.description: Optional programming language hint (e.g. 'solidity', 'typescript', 'python', 'rust', 'go'); auto-inferred if omitted.

tools.name: ai_reasoning_120b
tools.description: Runs OpenAI gpt-oss-120B chain-of-thought reasoning on Cloudflare Edge with configurable reasoning effort (low/medium/high) and optional strict JSON output mode. Use for hard math, planning, or strict-JSON single-prompt reasoning; use ai_nemotron_550b for multi-turn chat arrays or 550B synthesis, or ai_code_security_review for code audits. Read-only, stateless; costs $0.050 Base USDC via x402 (unpaid calls return a v2 quote challenge without charging; invalid inputs return 400 uncharged).

prompt.description: Primary problem statement, calculation, or reasoning task for the 120B model.

instructions.description: Optional system-level instructions, constraints, or output schema specification.

effort.description: Chain-of-thought reasoning depth: 'low' (fastest), 'medium' (balanced, default), or 'high' (deepest verification).

json_mode.description: When true, enforces valid JSON-only output in the final answer (default false).

tools.name: ai_nemotron_550b
tools.description: Calls NVIDIA Nemotron-3 Ultra 550B for complex multi-turn synthesis, architecture analysis, or open-ended reasoning with configurable temperature and token limits. Provide either 'prompt' or 'messages'. Use for 550B scale or multi-turn conversations; use ai_reasoning_120b when you need effort levels or strict JSON mode, or ai_vision_analyze for images. Read-only, stateless; costs $0.045 Base USDC via x402 (unpaid calls return a v2 quote challenge without charging; invalid inputs return 400 uncharged).

prompt.description: Single-turn user prompt. Required unless a multi-turn 'messages' array is provided.

system.description: Optional system prompt setting role, tone, or constraints when using 'prompt'.

messages.description: Optional OpenAI-style chat history array of {role, content} objects for multi-turn conversations (alternative to 'prompt').

max_tokens.description: Maximum completion tokens to generate (32-2048, default 1200).

temperature.description: Sampling temperature controlling creativity vs determinism (0.0-2.0, default 0.3).

tools.name: ai_vision_analyze
tools.description: Inspects an image via multimodal vision AI to perform OCR, chart/table extraction, UI inspection, or visual Q&A from either a public image_url or base64 image_base64. Use for understanding existing images; use gpu_flux_image to generate new images from text or gpu_audio_transcribe for audio files. Read-only, stateless; costs $0.040 Base USDC via x402 (unpaid calls return a v2 quote challenge without charging; invalid inputs return 400 uncharged).

image_url.description: Public HTTP/HTTPS URL of the image to analyze. Provide either 'image_url' or 'image_base64'.

image_base64.description: Raw base64-encoded image bytes or data URI. Provide either 'image_base64' or 'image_url'.

mime_type.description: MIME type of 'image_base64' when not supplied as a data URI (e.g. 'image/png', 'image/jpeg', 'image/webp').

prompt.description: Specific OCR, extraction, or visual analysis instruction (defaults to a comprehensive structured description).

tools.name: gpu_flux_image
tools.description: Generates high-speed raster images from a text prompt using Black Forest Labs FLUX.1 Schnell on Cloudflare Edge GPUs, returning JPEG base64 and a ready-to-embed data_url. Use to create new graphics, thumbnails, or avatars; use ai_vision_analyze to inspect or OCR an existing image. Read-only, stateless; costs $0.030 Base USDC via x402 (unpaid calls return a v2 quote challenge without charging; invalid inputs return 400 uncharged).

prompt.description: Detailed visual text prompt describing subject, composition, lighting, and style to render.

steps.description: Diffusion inference steps (1-8, default 4; higher values improve detail at slightly higher latency).

tools.name: gpu_audio_transcribe
tools.description: Transcribes speech or translates spoken audio to English using OpenAI Whisper Large v3 Turbo with VAD filtering, returning full text, detected language, and timestamped segments. Provide either audio_url (<=12MB) or audio_base64. Use for audio/podcast files; use ai_vision_analyze for images. Read-only, stateless; costs $0.030 Base USDC via x402 (unpaid calls return a v2 quote challenge without charging; invalid inputs return 400 uncharged).

audio_url.description: Public HTTP/HTTPS URL of an audio file (MP3/WAV/M4A/OGG, max 12MB). Provide either 'audio_url' or 'audio_base64'.

audio_base64.description: Base64-encoded audio file bytes. Provide either 'audio_base64' or 'audio_url'.

task.description: 'transcribe' keeps the original spoken language (default); 'translate' translates speech into English text.

language.description: Optional ISO-639-1 language hint (e.g. 'en', 'zh', 'es'); auto-detected when omitted.

tools.name: dev_deterministic_tools
tools.description: Executes zero-hallucination deterministic developer calculations across four explicit modes: 'cron' (next UTC run timestamps), 'json_diff' (RFC-6902 patch ops), 'jwt' (decode header/payload & expiry without signature verification), and 'semver' (exact version sort/max). Use for exact algorithmic checks; use ai_code_security_review for code auditing or ai_reasoning_120b for open-ended reasoning. Read-only, stateless; costs $0.002 Base USDC via x402 (unpaid calls return a v2 quote challenge without charging; invalid inputs return 400 uncharged).

mode.description: Operation mode: 'cron' (requires expression), 'json_diff' (requires before & after), 'jwt' (requires token), or 'semver' (requires versions).

expression.description: 5-field UTC cron expression (e.g. '0 */2 * * *'). Used only when mode is 'cron'.

count.description: Number of upcoming UTC schedule timestamps to compute (1-25, default 5). Used only when mode is 'cron'.

before.description: Original JSON value/object to compare from. Used only when mode is 'json_diff'.

after.description: Target JSON value/object to compare against. Used only when mode is 'json_diff'.

token.description: Compact JWS/JWT string ('header.payload.signature') to decode and check exp/nbf timestamps. Used only when mode is 'jwt'.

versions.description: Array of SemVer version strings (e.g. ['1.10.0', '1.2.3-beta.1', '2.0.0']) to sort and inspect. Used only when mode is 'semver'.

tools.name: llm_claude_sonnet
tools.description: Pay-per-call Anthropic Claude Sonnet 5.5 (pure zero-injection passthrough) with no Anthropic account or credit card required. Up to 10,000 input chars & 1,000 output tokens in Base USDC. Read-only, stateless; costs $0.015 Base USDC via x402 (unpaid calls return a v2 quote challenge without charging; invalid inputs return 400 uncharged).

tools.name: llm_gpt_frontier
tools.description: Pay-per-call OpenAI GPT-6.2 Astra full-IQ reasoning with zero OpenAI account or credit card required. Up to 12,000 input chars & 1,500 output tokens per Base USDC call. Read-only, stateless; costs $0.005 Base USDC via x402 (unpaid calls return a v2 quote challenge without charging; invalid inputs return 400 uncharged).

tools.name: llm_gemini_frontier
tools.description: Pay-per-call Google Gemini 4 Argon frontier reasoning with zero Google Cloud account required. Up to 12,000 input chars & 1,500 output tokens per Base USDC call. Read-only, stateless; costs $0.005 Base USDC via x402 (unpaid calls return a v2 quote challenge without charging; invalid inputs return 400 uncharged).
